text: スーパー　おにいさんショー　…って　ほどでも　ないけど　はじめまーす！

structure.jp: スーパー　おにいさんショー
…って　ほどでも　ないけど
structure.en: ...well, it's not really that much, but

patterns.name: 〜というほどでもない
patterns.span: って　ほどでも　ない
patterns.explanation: This says something doesn't quite deserve the name just given. って is the casual form of という. って　ほどでも　ない = 'it's not really enough to call it that'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. ほどでも　ないけど = 'it's not that grand, but'.
